Crime & Law · India

Multiple Arrests in Assault and Bribery Cases Across India

Several arrests have been made in separate incidents across India. In Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, a TDP leader and family members were arrested for allegedly assaulting a woman over a bribe dispute. Separately, in Tamil Nadu, police are investigating a conspiracy to bribe TVK MLAs, with a senior journalist questioned and money seized. In West Bengal, a former TMC councillor was arrested for a 2020 assault, and an MLA's family was summoned by the ED in a job scam probe.
